community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Meet the citizens driving change. Join us in building the future of Cuba, one idea at a time.
community.missionText: Para Salvar A Cuba is a democratic platform that empowers citizens to propose, discuss, and collectively shape the future of our nation. We believe that great change begins when diverse voices come together with a shared vision for positive transformation.
community.participationText: Every voice matters. We believe that everyone has valuable ideas to contribute, and together we can create more effective solutions.
community.inclusivityText: We welcome perspectives from all backgrounds and experiences. Our platform is designed to be accessible and welcoming to everyone in our community.
community.transparencyText: Open communication builds trust. We maintain transparency in how ideas are evaluated and how the community shapes our nation's future.
community.actionText: Ideas are only valuable when they lead to change. We are committed to turning community consensus into tangible action.
community.joinSubtitle: Share your vision for Cuba and connect with thousands of citizens who are already making a difference.

about.heroSubtitle: We believe in the power of ideas to transform Cuba. This is a free, open, and democratic space to imagine the future we want together.
about.storyQuote: "Cuba deserves a space where every voice counts."
about.storyBody: Para Salvar A Cuba was born from a simple conviction: the Cuban people — on the island and in the diaspora — deserve a platform to propose, debate, and prioritize ideas for their country's future. We are a community-driven space for peaceful, democratic change.
about.step1Desc: Share your idea with the community. Any topic that affects Cuba's future is welcome.
about.step2Desc: Vote and comment on other people's ideas. The best ideas rise to the top.
about.step3Desc: The most supported ideas gain visibility and become real proposals for change.
about.value1Desc: Every Cuban has the right to express their ideas without fear. We protect free speech and open dialogue.
about.value2Desc: All votes and ideas are public. Nothing is hidden. The process is open and auditable.
about.value3Desc: We are a community. We support each other's ideas even when we disagree, and we debate with respect.
about.value4Desc: Ideas without action are just dreams. We are committed to turning the best ideas into real change.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Para Salvar A Cuba is a civic platform that collects the minimum data necessary to operate. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how we protect it.
privacy.s1Body: We collect only your email address when you submit an idea, vote, or leave a comment. We do not collect names, phone numbers, location data, or any other personal information.
privacy.s2Body: Your email is used solely to associate your contributions with your account and to prevent abuse. We do not send marketing emails, and we do not share or sell your email to third parties under any circumstances.
privacy.s3Body: Only the portion of your email before the {'@'} symbol is displayed publicly next to your ideas and comments. The full address is never shown to other users.
privacy.s4Body: We retain your data for as long as your contributions remain on the platform. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.s5Body: We use a single session cookie to keep you signed in. We do not use tracking cookies or any third-party analytics.
privacy.s6Body: To request data deletion or ask questions about this policy, write to: privacy at parasalvaracuba.org

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using Para Salvar A Cuba you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.s1Body: Para Salvar A Cuba is a space for peaceful, democratic civic participation. Its purpose is to collect, discuss, and elevate ideas for Cuba's future. It is not affiliated with any political party or government.
terms.s2Body: You may submit ideas, vote, and comment. All contributions must be respectful and constructive. You are responsible for everything you publish under your account.
terms.s3Body: The following are strictly prohibited: hate speech or discrimination based on race, gender, religion, or sexual orientation; calls for violence; spam or commercial content; content that infringes third-party rights.
terms.s4Body: You retain ownership of the ideas you submit. By publishing on this platform you grant Para Salvar A Cuba a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display and distribute your content for the civic purposes of the platform.
terms.s5Body: We reserve the right to remove content that violates these terms without prior notice. Repeat violations may result in account suspension.
terms.s6Body: The platform is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability and are not liable for any damages arising from use of the platform.
terms.s7Body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.s8Body: Questions about these terms: legal at parasalvaracuba.org
